events.text: The body that became the IAB was created with the name Internet Configuration Control Board.

events.text: The ICCB was reorganized by Dr. Barry Leiner around a series of task forces.

events.text: The re-organized group was named the Internet Activities Board.

events.text: The IAB set for itself seven principal foci for the period of 1989 to 1990.

events.text: The IAB's seven principal foci period ended in 1990.
